description: Pass/fail thresholds for tools/bench/gate.ps1 (TEMPLAPTOP, AC, 60 Hz). Derived from the refresh period and what smooth zoom requires; anchor and snap-back thresholds calibrated against what simple rounding scores on the 2026-10-01 logs. Aggregation: 'median' = median of the runs (5 by default), so a bimodal metric cannot flip the result on one run; 'max'/'all' = worst run, used only for run-validity invariants. Metrics under 'derived.' are computed by tools/bench/derive.py from the raw frames/events (frozen), not by app code. Gesture metrics are bound-aware: refreshes/inputs while the zoom is pinned at 1x or 10x and input pushes into the bound are not scored. Rationale: docs/03_Technical_Architecture.md section 7.4.

criteria.why: Bench ran to the end (no watchdog/quit).
Without UIAccess MagSetFullscreenTransform fails silently (R-12); numbers would be meaningless.
Every transform update must land (R-12, AC-ERR.04).
Telemetry buffer must not overflow (bench validity).
A new zoom value on every refresh while a gesture is in motion; 1% for scheduler noise (AC-2.2.02/03). Refreshes pinned at a bound are not scored.
DWM composes once per refresh; a second update in one refresh is never shown, so steps become uneven.
Consecutive updates one refresh apart during a gesture; 10% for DwmFlush wake jitter.
No hole of two or more refreshes inside a gesture (visible hitch). With C-14 this asks wheel motion to keep moving ~90-100 ms after a notch.
No render-loop tick later than 1.5 periods (AC-2.3.10). Median: a one-off scheduler hiccup in one of five runs is noise.
MagSetFullscreenTransform stays a small fraction of the 16.7 ms frame.
The first zoom after launch must also render on the next frame (AC-2.2.01, R-24).
AC-2.2.01: input reaches a transform update within one period (+0.3 ms timer slack). Inputs that push into a bound are not scored.
Update within one period, shown at the following vblank: at most two periods input-to-photon (R-03).
After the last effective input the zoom comes to rest without perceptible catch-up (AC-2.2.03); below the 100-150 ms keyboard band of AC-2.2.04.
Anchor error relative to the whole-pixel floor (0.5 x zoom px per axis): rounding scores 0.94-0.98, truncation 1.76-1.96 (AC-2.1.09-11, R-23).
No update beyond the rounding floor (rounding scores <= 1.000, truncation up to 2.0); 1% for float-vs-double ideal.
Scrolling in and back out by the same amount returns to the same zoom (AC-2.1.06, R-17).
Anchor snap-backs (>= 1 px reversals) per still-pointer update pair. Rounding alone scores 13-51% (animated: 15-50%); a monotone zoom nudge <= 0.5% reached 0-11% in simulation.
Guard for C-18: the displayed zoom must not reverse direction mid-gesture unless the input did (baseline 0%; a free per-frame nudge scored 1-21%).
Guard for C-05/07/08: an isolated input is half applied within ~2 periods (baseline 4-16 ms), so smoothing cannot buy pacing with lag (AC-2.2.03).
Touchpad latency no worse than baseline (5-run medians 15.7-16.1 ms; AC-2.2.03 touchpad stays direct).
Touchpad input-to-photon no worse than baseline (5-run medians 30.8-31.2 ms).
Touchpad effectively direct: an isolated step is at least half applied within one period (baseline 4-14 ms).
